findings: FPhysScene constructor14200C730 sets sceneCount+4=(asyncEnabled byte+0!=0)+2 and initializes dispatcher+270+8*i only for i<sceneCount via142022930. Disabled async index2 (+280 dispatcher,+100 inFlight) must not be read as initialized.

142022930 no-native-thread branch allocates synchronous dispatcher0x18, vtable143976538, pointer+8=0,count+10=0,capacity+14=0. A null dispatcher is allocation failure, not verified normal absent-scene state; fail closed for every initialized slot.

14202E860 synchronous submit count+10 remains positive while original/nested task run+8/release+30 executes, drains nested local queue, then returns count0. Zero does not alone establish engine completion/publication.

142027E40 publishes scene+160 aggregate completion.142017820 clears/releases+160 at ENTRY before142028750 transforms and142015B80 notification callbacks.142018350 endphysics task chains incomplete+160 into its own completion or runs finish synchronously. Group5 plus proven complete predecessor groups and no nested prefix supplies publication ownership; null+160 alone does not.
CRI setter140056CE0 holds native outer mutex*(1444379E0) via1431CD1F4/1431CD24C around callback144437990 and user144437998 assignment.1431CD0D4/1431CD124 enter/leave Win32 critical section.

Worker140057EAC holds same outer mutex through14008FCB4->140090F80/14009230C recursion->140092974->registered140540E70->140544470. Callbackglobal144437990 has two reads in140092974 and setter write; managerdispatcher140544470 only verified directcaller140540E70; registration140540E70 only constructor140535DF0 dataref outside unwind metadata.

Alternate native sequence entry14008FF10 is finalization1400571BC; it first unregisters server1431CE038(0) and stops1431CDC64->1431CDAA0, then sequencefinalizes.1431CDAA0 requests exit+78 and waits worker completion+74, may invoke worker wakecallback+20 while waiting, then handleclose+68 and zeroes threadrecord. Not a lightweight ordinary-host-stop primitive.

Constructive ordinary hook removal: on original GT outside callbacks, without guard mutex or manager+D0 held, enter validated existing outerCRI mutex; then check guard activeCalls==0 and no retained task, removehook/trampoline while mutex remains held, leave callback registration unchanged, release outermutex. This prevents verified background worker from just entering target during unhook and delays rather than suppresses callbacks.

Lock order is outerCRI->managerD0/guard admission lock; never wait outerCRI while holding latter. Do not call serverstop or arbitraryaudio while holdingouterlock. Native lock itself must remain alive; sameGT no-engine-teardown and initializedaudio are preconditions.
limitations: Bounded native direct-call and verified registration closure for shipped integration, not proof against arbitrary external modules or rewritten callback pointers.

CRI outer mutex predicate is not yet a host implementation/live teardown demonstration. Host Stop must be originalGT, no overlapping native finalization, and safe detour-library removal under quiescence; missing/native mutex cannot be guessed valid.
Taskgroup order alone is insufficient if parent pumps/reenters or has unretired native tails. No partial-application completion, task cancellation, or B recovery is inferred.
